interpretation: Uncorrected observed differences on pairwise shared unambiguous codons in existing masks. Different codons encoding the same amino acid are counted as observations, not reconstructed synonymous substitutions. No dN/dS, dS, saturation test, branch rate or independent-sample inference. Pairs share taxa/sites/ancestry and repeated policy rows are not replicates. Same genus label is not evidence of monophyly. Summaries of divergence fractions use pairs with at least 100 shared called codons; all lower-overlap pairs remain explicit.
